label: Invoices
description: How invoices and credit notes are created. An approved invoice gets its payments recorded at once. A draft can still be edited or deleted in Xero: approve it there or in Swell, and the payments follow. Start with drafts. Invoice numbers, the layout and the branding come from your Xero organisation.

fields.label: Create invoices as
fields.description: Approved invoices get their payments recorded at once. Drafts wait for you to approve them in Xero or in Swell. Credit notes are created the same way.

fields.label: Account for sales
fields.description: The code or name of the Xero account that item sales are posted to.

fields.label: Account for shipping
fields.description: The code or name of the Xero account that shipping charges are posted to. Leave it empty to use the account for sales.
fields.placeholder: Leave empty to use the account for sales

fields.label: Create credit notes for refunds
fields.description: Each refund of an order that has a Xero invoice becomes a credit note for the same customer.
